user.title: Add a tablet
user.description: Give the tablet a name. A pairing token is generated on the next screen.

pair.title: Pair the HA Sidecar app
pair.description:
In the HA Sidecar app enter this Home Assistant URL and the token below, then press Submit here.

**Token:** `{token}`

launch_app.name: Launch app
launch_app.description: Launches an app on the tablet.

path.name: Path
path.description: Optional HA frontend path; only used for the HA companion app (homeassistant://navigate/<path>).

set_allowlist.name: Set allowed apps
set_allowlist.description: Sets which apps may run during lockdown.

set_alarm.name: Set alarm
set_alarm.description: Creates or updates a native alarm on the tablet.

alarm_id.name: Alarm ID
alarm_id.description: Reuse to update an existing alarm.

install_system_update.name: Install system update
install_system_update.description: Device owner only: installs an A/B OTA package from a URI readable by the system.

bring_to_front.name: Bring dashboard to front
bring_to_front.description: Brings the HA companion app to the front without restarting it.

path.name: Path
path.description: Optional dashboard path to navigate to.

set_alarm_enabled.name: Enable or disable alarm
set_alarm_enabled.description: Turns an existing alarm on or off without changing its time.

skip_next_alarm.name: Skip next alarm
skip_next_alarm.description: A repeating alarm does not ring on its next occurrence (call again to undo); a one-time alarm is turned off. Without an ID the alarm that rings next is used.

mute_alarms.name: Mute alarms
mute_alarms.description: Silences all alarms, for example while you are away. They keep their schedule and ring again when the mute ends.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to mute. Leave empty to mute until Unmute alarms is called.

start_timer.name: Start timer
start_timer.description: Starts a labeled countdown on the tablet. It is shown on the idle screen and rings when it ends; Home Assistant gets a timer_finished event.

label.name: Label
label.description: Name of the timer, shown on the tablet. Instead of the ID it also finds an existing timer.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: ID of the timer. Defaults to the label in lower case with underscores (Batch 1 becomes batch_1).

start_stopwatch.name: Start stopwatch
start_stopwatch.description: Starts a labeled count-up that is shown on the idle screen until it is cancelled.

label.name: Label
label.description: Name of the timer, shown on the tablet. Instead of the ID it also finds an existing timer.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: ID of the timer. Defaults to the label in lower case with underscores (Batch 1 becomes batch_1).

pause_timer.name: Pause timer
pause_timer.description: Pauses a running timer or stopwatch.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: ID of the timer. Defaults to the label in lower case with underscores (Batch 1 becomes batch_1).

label.name: Label
label.description: Name of the timer, shown on the tablet. Instead of the ID it also finds an existing timer.

resume_timer.name: Resume timer
resume_timer.description: Continues a paused timer or stopwatch.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: ID of the timer. Defaults to the label in lower case with underscores (Batch 1 becomes batch_1).

label.name: Label
label.description: Name of the timer, shown on the tablet. Instead of the ID it also finds an existing timer.

cancel_timer.name: Cancel timer
cancel_timer.description: Removes a timer or stopwatch without ringing.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: ID of the timer. Defaults to the label in lower case with underscores (Batch 1 becomes batch_1).

label.name: Label
label.description: Name of the timer, shown on the tablet. Instead of the ID it also finds an existing timer.

adjust_timer.name: Adjust timer
adjust_timer.description: Adds or removes time on a countdown.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: ID of the timer. Defaults to the label in lower case with underscores (Batch 1 becomes batch_1).

label.name: Label
label.description: Name of the timer, shown on the tablet. Instead of the ID it also finds an existing timer.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: Seconds to add; negative to remove.

init.title: Display inputs
init.description: Entities that drive the tablet's brightness logic. Everything else is configured with the entities of the device.

data_description.presence_entities: Any of these being on means someone is near the tablet (mmWave, PIR, ...). Optional: the tablet can also use its camera.
data_description.night_entity: On = night. A sun entity counts as night while below the horizon. Leave empty to use the night schedule on the tablet.
data_description.glance_entities: Up to 9 entities whose values are shown on the at-a-glance screen (temperature, energy, ...).
